title: Qorona: squashing factor synthetic coronal imagery from global MHD solutions
description:
Qorona is an open, model-agnostic post-processor that turns a global coronal magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) solution into an eclipse-like image by integrating the perpendicular squashing factor (log10 Q-perp) along the line of sight, rendering the quasi-separatrix layers and separatrices that shape the fine structure seen at a total solar eclipse. Each coronal model and file format sits behind a single reader interface, so the whole pipeline runs on any solution once a reader exists; a field-line painting volume builder decouples interior resolution from cost, and the engine is validated against an analytic dipole whose Q-perp is known in closed form.

This repository is for the paper "Qorona: Open, Model-Agnostic Line-of-Sight Rendering of the Perpendicular Squashing Factor for Eclipse-like Coronal Imaging" by Rayan Dhib et al., The Astrophysical Journal (2026), doi: 10.3847/1538-4357/aea841. It is associated with the manuscript number AAS78638.

Source repository: https://github.com/RayanDhib/Qorona. Documentation: https://rayandhib.github.io/Qorona/. Package: https://pypi.org/project/qorona/. Concept DOI for all versions: 10.5281/zenodo.20630699. The README of the archived release describes installation, the quickstart and the supported models for this version.
